UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Permanent user account profile, credit balance, avatar configuration, and personalized Glitch AI v1.0 preferences

userId.description: The Firebase Auth UID of the user

avatarColor.description: Color theme id for the default avatar

customAvatar.description: Base64 data URL of user uploaded device profile picture

customInstructions.description: Custom prompt instructions injected into Glitch AI

credits.description: Remaining credit balance (starts at 100, 0-10 lucky credits per ad view, transferable between users)

lastClaimedTransferId.description: Most recently claimed incoming credit transfer document ID

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest profile update

ChatThread.title: ChatThread
ChatThread.description: Conversation thread metadata belonging to a user

id.description: Unique identifier of the chat thread

messageCount.description: Total number of messages in thread

lastMessageSnippet.description: Preview snippet of the last message

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when thread was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when thread was updated

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: An individual message within a chat thread

threadId.description: ID of the parent chat thread

userId.description: UID of the user who owns this message or thread

role.description: Role of the author: user or assistant

generatedImageUrl.description: Compressed image URL or data URL for persisted visual outputs

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when message was created

CreditDirectoryEntry.title: CreditDirectoryEntry
CreditDirectoryEntry.description: Privacy-preserving lookup index mapping hashed email or UID tokens to recipient display info without exposing plaintext emails

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest directory update

CreditTransfer.title: CreditTransfer
CreditTransfer.description: Atomic two-phase credit transfer record between signed-in users

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when transfer was sent

claimedAt.description: Server timestamp when recipient claimed credits

/users/{userId}.description: Permanent user profile and credit balance documents isolating user private data

/users/{userId}/threads/{threadId}.description: Chat conversation threads owned by the user

/users/{userId}/threads/{threadId}/messa.description: Individual messages belonging to a chat thread

/creditDirectory/{lookupId}.description: Hashed-email and UID recipient lookup entries (single-doc get only, listing forbidden)

/creditTransfers/{transferId}.description: Atomic two-phase credit transfer records readable only by sender or recipient
